name: Philip
summary: A man from Bethsaida whom Jesus called to follow Him, and one of the twelve apostles. He brought Nathanael to Jesus and later asked Jesus to show them the Father.

key_moments.title: Come and See
key_moments.description: Jesus found Philip and told him to follow Him. Philip found Nathanael and said they had found the one Moses wrote about, and when Nathanael doubted, Philip told him to come and see.

key_moments.title: Bread for the Crowd
key_moments.description: Seeing a great crowd, Jesus asked Philip where they could buy bread, to test him. Philip answered that two hundred pennies' worth would not be enough for each to have a little.

key_moments.title: Greeks Who Wanted Jesus
key_moments.description: Some Greeks came to Philip asking to see Jesus. Philip told Andrew, and together they told Jesus.

key_moments.title: Show Us the Father
key_moments.description: Philip asked Jesus to show them the Father. Jesus answered that whoever has seen Him has seen the Father.
